node.statement: Accordingly, lem-extcb-four-corner-merge can be instantiated only after adding the missing hypothesis that the four fixed level-one corner maps are bijective.  Under that strengthened antecedent, 1.2 gives rho+epsilon_{A_R}<=(C_cross^0+1)t<=a_merge, so the external would yield the claimed extended C_merge*(rho+epsilon_{A_R})-isomorphism; under the actual root antecedent it yields nothing.
